title: Cathie Wood Bought Just 3 Stocks On Monday; Here They Are
author: Rick Munarriz
description: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest made selective purchases on Monday, adding to positions in Nvidia, SoFi Technologies, and Scribe Therapeutics despite a generally bullish market day. Nvidia faced headwinds from a spy scandal investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang but remains attractively valued. SoFi showed strong fundamentals with 35% member growth and 44% revenue increase, though it's down 41% over the past year. Scribe Therapeutics, a gene-editing biotech, has sufficient cash runway through early 2029.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite a 4% decline due to CEO scandal investigation, the stock is attractively valued at 11.2x forward earnings with expected 90% revenue/earnings growth. However, the investigation creates uncertainty about leadership and business relationships, offsetting the positive valuation metrics.

Strong operational metrics with 35% member growth to 17.1 million, 44% revenue growth, and accelerating bottom-line growth with raised guidance. Trading at reasonable valuation multiples. Despite 41% decline over past year, fundamentals support future growth potential.

Early-stage gene-editing biotech with promising proprietary ELXR platform and strong balance sheet funding operations through early 2029. However, it remains a long-term speculative play dependent on scientific validation, with 22% decline over the past year.
